sections.heading: The biology investigation: replication, variability and 24 marks
paragraphs: The internally assessed investigation carries 20 per cent of the biology grade, has a 3,000-word ceiling, and is marked out of 24 across four criteria at six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. A fifth of the grade awarded without time pressure makes it the most recoverable part of the course, and the part most often started in the term when every other Diploma deadline arrives.

Biology has a design problem the other sciences do not share to the same degree, which is biological variability. Living material varies between individuals for reasons unconnected to the independent variable, and a design with three repeats cannot distinguish a real effect from that variation. Research design and data analysis both depend on replication being sufficient and on the student knowing why. The most common Dubai biology investigation failure is a well-conceived question with a sample size that cannot support a conclusion.

The second failure is treating variability as experimental error. An uncertainty in a thermometer reading and the spread in germination rates across thirty seeds are different things, and the evaluation criterion rewards a student who can say which dominated and why. Students who write about equipment precision when the dominant source of spread was the organism itself have missed the biology in their own data.

The boundary matters and should be agreed before the first session. A tutor may teach experimental design, question whether a research question and sample size can support a conclusion, teach how to treat variability and process data, name the criteria and their mark allocations, and give written feedback on a draft the student wrote. A tutor may not design the investigation, supply data, or write any part of the report. Work that is not the student's own produces a malpractice finding against the student rather than the provider. One UAE-facing site advertises completed Internal Assessments at AED 3,750.

sections.heading: Higher and Standard Level biology: more of the same, mostly
paragraphs: Both levels share the component structure and the four investigation criteria, and Higher Level adds substantial content with longer papers. The important point for cost planning is the character of the addition: in biology, Higher Level is largely more material of the same kind rather than a step into a different sort of thinking. Genetics gains real logical difficulty at Higher Level, and physiology gains depth, but most of the extension is volume.

That matters because volume is the cheap problem. A Higher Level biology student who is behind is usually behind on coverage, and coverage responds to retrieval practice at the bottom tier. The same student at Higher Level physics or Higher Level mathematics would be facing an increase in abstraction, which does require specialist teaching. Families who buy Higher Level biology support at the same tier as Higher Level physics support are frequently buying more than the subject requires.

The exception is worth naming precisely. Higher Level genetics — dihybrid crosses, linkage, chi-squared analysis of inheritance data — is the part of biology where a student can be defeated by the reasoning rather than by the quantity. That is mid-band or specialist work and it is worth paying for. Identifying whether a Higher Level biology problem is genetics logic or general coverage is a single diagnostic session and it changes the cost of the whole plan.

University requirements are the other input and they are published by each institution. Most medicine, dentistry and veterinary routes expect Higher Level biology or chemistry, often both; biomedical and life-science courses vary; some health and environmental courses accept Standard Level. Read the requirement for the actual courses on the student's list rather than inferring it, and note that tutoring is not a requirement for any admission or equivalency process.

sections.heading: Monthly budgeting across the two Diploma years
paragraphs: Hourly rates obscure the figure a family actually plans around, so convert them. One weekly 60-minute session across a Dubai academic year is roughly 36 sessions. The Bestimate survey's monthly estimates for weekly one-hour sessions run AED 240-600 at the budget tier, AED 600-1,200 mid-market and AED 1,000-2,000 or more for specialist exam-year work. Advertised monthly packages in the market include AED 799 for eight online sessions and AED 1,599-1,799 for four two-hour in-home visits.

For biology specifically, a well-sequenced plan does not need a weekly session at the qualified band across two years. Diploma Year 1 can be mostly retrieval practice at the bottom tier plus three or four investigation planning sessions late in the year. Diploma Year 2 adds a marking block of six to eight sessions on Paper 2 command terms, plus investigation drafting. The paid mid-band total across both years is often under twenty hours.

The alternative — weekly sessions in biology at the qualified band across two years — is roughly seventy hours. Both plans are defensible for a student who needs sustained teaching. For the much larger group whose problem is coverage and technique, the first plan costs a third as much and addresses the same marks, and the difference is sequencing rather than quality.

The table sets out the two shapes. Figures for school fees are deliberately absent because fee bands are school-specific and published per school by KHDA; one relevant piece of context is that KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that private school fees in Dubai would not rise for the 2026-27 academic year, under an economic incentives package valued at AED 1.5 billion.

sections.heading: What a Dubai family should refuse to pay for
paragraphs: The first is assessed work. One UAE-facing site advertises completed Internal Assessments at AED 3,750. Buying submitted work is a malpractice matter falling on the student, with the Diploma itself at stake rather than a grade, and no price makes that a reasonable transaction. A tutor teaches, questions, names criteria and gives feedback on work the student produced; anything past that line is not a service.

The second is a promise about a grade. Grade boundaries are determined after a session on the basis of candidate performance across the whole cohort, so the mark required for a given grade is not knowable while the teaching is happening. A provider offering a specific grade, a specific lift in marks or money back on a result is describing a sales position. What can honestly be committed to is procedural: a marked question after every session, a recorded score, written feedback on the student's own work.

The third is a rating with nothing behind it. Competitor pages in this market publish star ratings and review counts that contradict each other within a single page, including one showing a perfect score from twenty reviews alongside a claim of several thousand students taught. Review markup that is not backed by countable, attributable reviews is a structured-data violation and, as a commercial representation in the UAE, a consumer-protection exposure.

The fourth is a reproduced resource library. IB syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes and grade-boundary tables belong to the International Baccalaureate, and a provider circulating bundles of them is telling you how it treats rules in general. The correct behaviour is to reference and link the official source at ibo.org. IB Gram does neither reproduce nor distribute them, and holds no approval, accreditation, licence or partnership from the International Baccalaureate, KHDA, the Ministry of Education or MoHRE.
bullets: Completed assessed work, at any price, because the student carries the consequence
Grade promises, which are not available honestly before boundaries are set

sections.heading: Dubai's regulatory context and the hours a student actually has
paragraphs: Dubai's private schools are regulated by the Knowledge and Human Development Authority, which is responsible for enhancing and overseeing the quality of private education in the emirate and inspects annually against six bands from Outstanding to Very Weak. The sector held 387,441 students across 227 private schools in 2024-25, offering 17 different curricula, and seven new private schools were approved for the 2026-27 intake, three of them International Baccalaureate, adding 16,846 places, with enrolment up six per cent during 2025-26.

The mandatory-subject requirement is the piece of regulation that constrains a tutoring plan. Arabic, Islamic Education and Social and Moral studies are taught in all Dubai private schools regardless of the licensed international curriculum, with KHDA's requirements due to be implemented by the start of the 2025-26 academic year. Schools must organise separate classes for Arab and non-Arab students in Arabic as a first language, Islamic Education and Social Studies, and combined classes for the two groups are prohibited. Instructional time is calculated on a 40-minute lesson unit, with KHDA advising no such lesson falls below 25 minutes.

For a biology plan built on retrieval practice this matters directly, because retrieval practice needs several short slots a week and those slots have to exist. A Diploma student carrying six subjects, the core, CAS and two or three mandatory UAE subjects has a smaller discretionary week than a plan on paper assumes. Twenty-five minutes four times a week is achievable; ninety minutes four times a week is not, and a plan that assumes the latter fails quietly.

Two closing points. For the mandatory subjects, the use of different or additional content without prior permission from the Ministry of Education is prohibited, and teachers of Islamic Education and Arabic must hold the relevant approval from KHDA. And private tutoring in the UAE requires the MoHRE private tuition work permit introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, granted free of charge for two years; because it is free, no provider can justify a charge on licensing grounds.

process.title: Say which kind of biology problem it is
process.description: The useful opening message distinguishes three things: cannot recall the content, can recall it and loses marks on paper, or stuck on the investigation. Those three need different tiers at different costs. An enquiry that says only 'needs help with biology' gets priced defensively, which means at the top.

process.title: Free 30-minute trial lesson, one per family
process.description: Live video with the matched tutor, no card details taken, no obligation. It is spent on one Paper 2 style question marked live against the published scheme with the command term named, because that shows whether the problem is recall or technique and therefore which tier you need.

process.title: The honest tier recommendation
process.description: After the diagnostic you get told which parts of the plan belong at the bottom tier or can be run without a tutor at all. For a pure coverage problem that recommendation may be retrieval practice and nothing else for a term, which is a smaller sale and the correct answer.

process.title: A marking block with a stated end
process.description: Where command-term technique is the issue, six to eight sessions at the qualified band with every question marked to the published scheme before the session and the loss tagged by verb. The block has an end date, because the habit either changes within it or the diagnosis was wrong.

process.title: Investigation sessions against school deadlines
process.description: Three or four sessions placed around the school's own internal deadlines, starting with whether the research question and sample size can support a conclusion given biological variability. Changing a question early is cheap; discovering the replication problem at draft stage is not.

process.title: Re-cost at the halfway point
process.description: Mid-plan the retrieval scores and the marked scripts are read together. Where coverage has come good and the losses have moved to technique, the tier changes. Where both have come good, the plan ends. An hour count can be reduced; a monthly subscription is designed not to be.

whyPoints.title: Priced from the bottom up
whyPoints.description: The page starts at AED 33-65 an hour rather than at the premium band, because a large share of biology problems genuinely belong there. Naming what the cheap tier does well is more useful to a Dubai family than another argument for buying the expensive one.

whyPoints.title: What each tier cannot do is stated
whyPoints.description: The budget tier cannot mark against a published scheme or against the four investigation criteria. The premium tier cannot provide access to marking, boundaries or paper content. Knowing both limits is what lets a family place each task correctly.

whyPoints.title: Retrieval practice separated from paid teaching
whyPoints.description: The largest lever in biology is spaced self-testing, which needs administration rather than expertise. Recommending it at the bottom tier or with no tutor at all is a smaller sale and the honest answer for a content-volume problem.

whyPoints.title: Marking blocks have end dates
whyPoints.description: Command-term work is six to eight sessions with a stated finish, because the habit either changes inside that window or the diagnosis was wrong. A technique fix sold as a year-long weekly commitment is a technique fix being used as a subscription.

whyPoints.title: Replication addressed before data collection
whyPoints.description: Biological variability is the design problem specific to this subject, and three repeats on living material cannot separate an effect from natural spread. Settling sample size before collection is the difference between an investigation that can conclude something and one that cannot.

whyPoints.title: Every figure attributed and dated
whyPoints.description: Each AED band here names the provider or survey that published it and the month it was read. Three of the six pages ranking for Dubai tutoring queries publish no price at all, and two quote in US dollars, which leaves a parent without a benchmark.

faqs.question: What is the cheapest way to improve an IB biology grade in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Spaced retrieval practice, which can be run at the bottom of the market or at no cost at all. Diploma biology carries a large body of content and little calculation, so the characteristic failure is understanding the material in October and being unable to retrieve it in May. Retrieval is built by testing rather than by reading or listening: twenty to thirty minutes of scored self-testing against the syllabus statements, three or four times a week, with the interval increasing as recall becomes reliable. It needs administration rather than subject expertise, which is exactly why it does not belong at a specialist rate.

faqs.question: What can an AED 45 an hour biology tutor in Dubai actually do?
faqs.answer: Content explanation, worked examples and supervised question practice, usually delivered by a university student. EdFlik publishes online tuition from AED 45-65 and Tutopiya from AED 33-52, read in October 2026. For a student whose problem is recalling a process or a structure, that is a sufficient and sensible purchase. What the tier reliably cannot do is mark a Paper 2 answer against the published scheme or read an investigation draft against research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. A family buying criterion-referenced work at that rate is paying for something they are not getting.

faqs.question: Which biology tasks genuinely need a mid-band or specialist tutor?
faqs.answer: Two, and they account for most of the grade. Command-term discipline on Paper 2, which carries 44 per cent, where the lost marks are technique rather than knowledge and the correction requires someone who knows what the mark scheme pays for. And the investigation, which carries 20 per cent and cannot be done well without someone who can read a draft against four criteria at six marks each. Higher Level genetics is the third, because dihybrid crosses, linkage and chi-squared analysis can defeat a student on reasoning rather than on volume. Everything else is usually cheaper.

faqs.question: Why does my child understand biology but lose marks in the exams?
faqs.answer: Usually command terms, and it is one habit rather than many gaps. State wants a fact. Describe wants observable detail. Explain wants a causal chain. Deduce wants a conclusion from information given in the question. Distinguish wants both sides placed against each other. A student who writes a description every time loses marks across both papers simultaneously, which looks like a subject-wide weakness. The concept takes twenty minutes to explain and about three weeks of verb-tagged marking to change, and the gain appears across every topic at once because the habit is topic-independent.

faqs.question: How many values and repeats does an IB biology investigation need?
faqs.answer: Enough to separate a real effect from biological variation, which is the design problem specific to this subject. Living material varies between individuals for reasons unconnected to the independent variable, so a design with three repeats usually cannot support a conclusion however carefully it was executed. Research design and data analysis both depend on replication being sufficient and on the student explaining why it is. The most common Dubai biology investigation failure is a good question with a sample size too small to say anything, and it is detectable before any data is collected.

faqs.question: What is the difference between biological variability and experimental uncertainty?
faqs.answer: An uncertainty in a thermometer reading is a property of the instrument. The spread in germination rates across thirty seeds is a property of the organisms. The evaluation criterion rewards a student who can say which of the two dominated their results and how it limits the conclusion drawn. Students who write about equipment precision when the organism was the dominant source of spread have missed the biology in their own data, and that is a six-mark criterion being partly given away. It is taught before data collection rather than reconstructed afterwards.

faqs.question: Is Higher Level biology much harder than Standard Level?
faqs.answer: It carries substantially more content and longer papers, but the character of the addition matters for planning: in biology most of the extension is volume rather than a step into a different kind of thinking. That makes a Higher Level biology student who is behind usually behind on coverage, and coverage is the cheap problem. The exception is Higher Level genetics, where dihybrid crosses, linkage and chi-squared analysis introduce genuine logical difficulty. Identifying whether the problem is genetics reasoning or general coverage takes one diagnostic session and changes the cost of the whole plan.

faqs.question: What does a monthly biology tutoring budget look like in Dubai?
faqs.answer: It depends entirely on sequencing. The Bestimate survey's monthly estimates for weekly one-hour sessions run AED 240-600 at the budget tier, AED 600-1,200 mid-market and AED 1,000-2,000 or more for specialist exam-year work, and advertised packages include AED 799 for eight online sessions. A sequenced biology plan — retrieval practice at the bottom tier in Year 1, a six-to-eight session marking block in Year 2, plus investigation coaching — often totals under twenty paid mid-band hours across both Diploma years. A weekly qualified-band session across the same period is roughly seventy.

faqs.question: Do data-based questions in IB biology need separate practice?
faqs.answer: Yes, and they are the most commonly neglected marks in the subject. Paper 1's data-based section and many Paper 2 questions supply a table or graph, and the mark scheme requires the figure to be quoted. A biologically correct answer that cites no data scores less than a thinner one that does. The related trap is the causal claim: a question asking what the data show is not asking why, and explaining mechanism where description was requested loses the mark. Drilling multiple-choice questions does not touch any of this, which is why students who revise that way are surprised by Paper 1.

faqs.question: Is in-home biology tutoring in Dubai worth the premium?
faqs.answer: Only if attention management is the real problem. The Bestimate survey puts qualified in-home one-to-one at AED 180-350 an hour, with independent home tutors quoted at AED 200-500, against AED 150-300 for comparable work online, and the premium rises with distance from the central tutoring clusters. The premium pays for a commute. Biology is the best-supplied Diploma science in this emirate, so there is no scarcity argument for restricting the pool to driving distance. IB Gram does not offer home visits in Dubai or anywhere in the UAE; that is an India-only service.

faqs.question: Can a tuition-centre group class replace one-to-one biology support?
faqs.answer: For content coverage, often yes. A group class can work through a syllabus efficiently when everyone is at the same level, and the per-student rate is the lowest of the three formats in this market. What it cannot do is read one student's investigation draft against four criteria, or mark their Paper 2 answers against the verb they misread. The sensible combination for a price-sensitive Dubai family is group or self-directed work for content plus a small number of one-to-one hours aimed precisely at the individually assessed components.

faqs.question: What may a tutor do with an IB biology investigation?
faqs.answer: Teach experimental design, question whether a research question and sample size can support a conclusion given biological variability, teach data processing and the treatment of spread, name the four criteria and their six marks each, and give written feedback on a draft the student wrote. What a tutor may not do is design the investigation, supply data or write any part of the report. Work that is not the student's own produces a malpractice finding against the student rather than the provider who sold it. One UAE-facing site advertises completed Internal Assessments at AED 3,750.

faqs.question: Is Standard Level biology enough for a medicine application?
faqs.answer: Read the requirement for the specific courses on the student's list, because it varies by institution and by course and is published by each university rather than inferable. Most medicine, dentistry and veterinary routes expect Higher Level biology or chemistry and often both. Biomedical and life-science courses differ considerably. Some health and environmental courses accept Standard Level. That afternoon of reading settles more of the level decision than any amount of discussion, and it is worth noting that tutoring is not a requirement for any admission process or for Ministry of Education equivalency.

faqs.question: Why does a Dubai Diploma student have so little time for retrieval practice?
faqs.answer: Because the week is fuller than a plan assumes. Six Diploma subjects plus Theory of Knowledge, the Extended Essay and CAS already fill it, and Dubai private schools additionally teach Arabic, Islamic Education and Social and Moral studies regardless of the licensed curriculum, with separate classes required for Arab and non-Arab students in several of those subjects and instructional time calculated on a 40-minute lesson unit. The practical consequence is that retrieval practice has to be designed in short slots. Twenty-five minutes four times a week is achievable; ninety minutes four times a week is a plan that fails quietly.

faqs.question: What if we book biology support and the diagnosis says we do not need it?
faqs.answer: You get told, and the recommendation is written down. For a pure coverage problem the honest answer is often retrieval practice at the bottom tier or run by the student alone for a term, with a review afterwards. That is a smaller sale and it is the correct advice, because paying a qualified or specialist rate for someone to read recall questions aloud is the most common overspend in Diploma biology. A provider whose revenue depends on a rolling monthly subscription has no reason to give that answer, which is worth knowing before signing one.

dubai/ib-biology-tutor.closingHeading: Place the task at the right tier before buying hours
dubai/ib-biology-tutor.closingBody: Biology is the Diploma science where sequencing saves the most money, because the biggest lever in the subject needs discipline rather than expertise. Decide first which of three problems you have: cannot recall the content, can recall it and loses marks on paper, or stuck on the investigation. The first belongs at the bottom tier or at no cost. The second is a six-to-eight session marking block. The third is three or four sessions against the school's deadlines. Send the level and the last marked paper, take the free 30-minute trial lesson, and ask for a plan with a stated hour count and a stated end.

dubai/ib-business-tutor.tutorsIntro: The tutors below cover IB Business Management at Standard and Higher Level, including the business research project and the quantitative content in Paper 2. Matching is done on what the student is losing marks for, because explaining a stakeholder map and marking an 1,800-word research project against criteria are different jobs.

intro.heading: Working up from the cheapest Business tutor in Dubai, rather than down from the dearest
paragraphs: Most tutoring pages start with their best tutor and work down, which tells a parent nothing about whether they are overbuying. This one starts at the floor. Tutopiya advertises from AED 33 to 52 an hour and EdFlik from AED 45 to 65; that is the bottom of the published Dubai market, and it usually buys a graduate or university student working through a textbook with the student. For a DP1 Business candidate who simply has not understood the difference between cash flow and profit, that purchase is sometimes correct and the saving is real.

The next band up changes what you get rather than how much of it. Unitors publishes IB rates from AED 200 and TutorChase quotes AED 270 for a qualified subject tutor working online. The difference is marking: somebody in this band can read a Paper 2 answer and say which of the quantitative marks were available and left behind, and can quote the research project criteria without looking them up. BartyED charges AED 650 for a premium named tutor, which prices scarcity in a specific individual rather than a different syllabus.

The in-home market sits across those bands and adds a travel component. Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 table puts home visits at AED 180 to 350 and specialist exam-year subject tutors at AED 200 to 450 or more, while market home tutors are quoted from AED 200 to 500. Advertised monthly packages run AED 799 for eight online sessions against AED 1,599 to 1,799 for four two-hour in-home visits. Those two package prices, side by side, are the plainest statement available of what driving across Dubai costs.

Deciding which band a family needs comes down to the component at risk. Content gaps in DP1 sit comfortably in the lower bands. Paper 2 quantitative technique, HL extension topics and the business research project do not, because those need somebody who marks rather than somebody who explains. Business Management is unusual in that the two requirements are genuinely separable, which means a family can buy cheap early and expensive late instead of paying the same rate for two years.

IB Gram does not offer home visits in the UAE. In-home tutoring is a service we run only in India, and nothing here should be read as an offer to send someone to a Dubai address. Business support for Dubai families runs one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time, scheduled around the school day, and that is what lets a family hire the person who marks the component rather than the person who lives nearby.

One more framing point before the tables. Dubai's private school sector served 387,441 students across 227 schools offering 17 different curricula in 2024-25, and Business Management is among the most heavily subscribed Group 3 options in the Diploma Programme schools inside that figure. A popular subject produces good classroom teaching and a crowded market for exam-term specialists, which is why availability rather than price is often the binding constraint in February.

dubai/ib-business-tutor.programmesIntro: Business Management is a Diploma Programme course, but the request for help arrives from students on several different routes through the IB in Dubai, and each arrives with a different gap.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Business Management sits in Group 3 and runs at Standard or Higher Level over two years. Students work through introduction to business management, human resource management, finance and accounts, marketing and operations management, with additional extension content at Higher Level. Assessment is two examination papers plus an internally assessed business research project on a real organisation, capped at 1,800 words.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai DP Business cohorts are usually larger than Economics cohorts in the same school, because the course is seen as the practical option. That makes local teaching stronger and local tutoring thinner at the top end, since more students chasing the same handful of specialists in the exam term produces the shortage families notice in February.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: The CP pairs DP courses with a career-related study, and business is the most common career strand, so Business Management is the most frequently paired DP course on this route. CP students sit the same papers and submit the same research project as DP candidates for that subject, with a reflective project and a personal and professional skills course in place of the full DP core.
programmes.countryNote: Business is where the CP makes most sense in Dubai, given the emirate's commercial economy and the number of students heading towards business degrees or family firms. The tutoring need is usually narrower than for a full DP candidate: exam technique for two papers and criteria coaching on the research project, with less pressure from competing subjects.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: There is no MYP Business course, but MYP Individuals and Societies and the MYP design cycle both feed it. Students arrive in DP1 able to research and present, and frequently unable to apply a named analytical tool to a specific firm and reach a defensible conclusion. That application step is the whole of Business Management.
programmes.countryNote: The MYP to DP Business transition is easier than the MYP to DP Economics one, because the content is concrete and the vocabulary familiar from daily life in a commercial city. The hidden difficulty is the opposite of abstraction: students write confidently about businesses they know and forget to apply any framework at all, which caps the mark.

programmes.name: Primary Years Programme
programmes.description: No business content and no honest claim to the contrary. PYP units occasionally touch enterprise through transdisciplinary themes, and children in Dubai often encounter small-business ideas through school markets, but none of this is Business Management and none of it should be sold as preparation for it.
programmes.countryNote: For parents planning ahead from the primary years in Dubai, the useful point is that Business Management is chosen in Year 11 and that the mathematics route taken alongside it matters to the quantitative half of Paper 2. Numeracy built early does more for an eventual Business grade than any early subject exposure.

dubai/ib-business-tutor.subjectsIntro: Business requests from Dubai families rarely arrive alone, and the combinations are predictable. These are the courses most often bundled with a Business Management enquiry, with what each one actually contributes.

subjects.name: Business Management
subjects.description: Five content areas plus Higher Level extensions, two examination papers and an 1,800-word research project on a real organisation. Marks are lost through tools named but not applied, conclusions that do not follow from the analysis, and quantitative questions attempted without working shown.

subjects.name: Economics
subjects.description: The Group 3 neighbour, and the source of constant confusion. Economics rewards theoretical modelling with real-world illustration; Business rewards application to a named organisation. Writing one in the register of the other reliably costs a band in both.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: The natural mathematics partner. Financial mathematics, statistics and interpretation of data overlap directly with Business Paper 2 quantitative content, including break-even, ratio analysis and simple investment appraisal.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: Chosen by Business students aiming at quantitative finance or economics degrees abroad. The course teaches no business content, but algebraic fluency removes the arithmetic hesitation that costs marks in timed data response work.

subjects.name: English A: Language and Literature
subjects.description: Carries the writing discipline Business depends on. A Business extended response is an argument with a recommendation at the end, and students whose paragraphing is loose produce answers an examiner cannot follow to a conclusion.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Useful alongside the human resource management content: motivation theory, leadership and organisational culture all sit close to Psychology material, and students taking both can make abstract models concrete with real evidence.

subjects.name: Global Politics
subjects.description: Supports the external environment content. Students who study power, sovereignty and development write better about multinational operations and regulatory constraint than those working from a single textbook chapter.

subjects.name: Digital Society
subjects.description: Overlaps with operations, marketing and the ethics of data use. Students taking both tend to produce stronger research projects, because they ask better questions about how an organisation actually runs its systems.

subjects.name: Theory of Knowledge
subjects.description: Changes Business marks more than students expect. The habit of asking how a claim is justified is what turns a recommendation into a defensible one, and unjustified recommendations are the single most common cap on an extended response.

subjects.name: Arabic B
subjects.description: Commonly carried alongside Business by Dubai students, and relevant to the research project where the chosen organisation operates in Arabic. Primary research conducted in Arabic is legitimate and under-used.

dubai/ib-business-tutor.regionsTitle: Dubai communities Business enquiries come from
dubai/ib-business-tutor.regionsIntro: Business requests arrive from across the emirate, and what differs by community is the shape of the request rather than its subject: whether the family is buying early content support or late project supervision, and how much evening time is already spoken for.

regions.name: Business Bay and Downtown Dubai
regions.note: Apartment living with many parents working in commercial roles minutes away. Business Management is a popular choice here and enquiries are often made by a parent who knows the subject matter and wants criteria coaching rather than content teaching.

regions.name: Dubai Marina and JLT
regions.note: Dense towers, high turnover and frequent mid-programme arrivals. Research project enquiries from this cluster often involve a student whose chosen organisation was in another country and who needs to reframe the project around something they can actually research.

regions.name: Mirdif and Al Warqa
regions.note: Established family housing further east, where the commute to the DP-heavy western corridor is long. The travel element inside an in-home quote is largest from here, which is why the online comparison matters most to families in this cluster.

regions.name: Arabian Ranches and Dubai Sports City
regions.note: Villa communities organised around a handful of schools, with heavy sport commitments. Business blocks are usually booked late in the evening, and the research project tends to be the trigger rather than Paper 1.

regions.name: Al Barsha and Tecom
regions.note: A mix of IB and British curriculum schools within a small radius, so siblings often sit different qualifications. Families here frequently ask how IGCSE Business differs from DP Business Management before committing a child to the route.

regions.name: Dubai Hills Estate and Al Quoz
regions.note: Newer housing adjacent to commercial and industrial areas, which is useful for a research project needing a local organisation willing to answer questions. Primary research is more feasible here than families realise.

regions.name: Al Furjan and Discovery Gardens
regions.note: Rapid residential growth with schooling spread in several directions, so one household can be on three different timetables. Video delivery removes the scheduling knot a single travelling tutor would create across those pick-up times.

schoolClusters.city: Dubai schools with large DP Business cohorts
schoolClusters.note: Schools where Business Management is a well-subscribed option with settled teaching and plenty of internal benchmarking. Students we support from these schools usually want research project criteria work or Paper 2 quantitative technique rather than content from scratch.

schoolClusters.city: Dual-pathway and newer IB schools
schoolClusters.note: Schools offering the Diploma Programme alongside A Levels or running it more recently, where Business option blocks can be tighter and Higher Level may depend on numbers. Enquiries here often start with whether to take Business at HL or SL.

schoolClusters.city: British-curriculum schools weighing the DP
schoolClusters.note: Schools running IGCSE Business and A Level Business whose students sometimes transfer into the Diploma Programme. The conversation with these families is usually about how an 1,800-word research project differs from an A Level coursework component.

dubai/ib-business-tutor.modesIntro: Business support splits cleanly between content work, project supervision and examination technique, and the three are worth buying at different rates and different times. All run over live video, never at a UAE address.

modes.title: Content catch-up in DP1
modes.description: Weekly or fortnightly sessions through the first year, working through the five content areas in the order the school teaches them. This is the mode where the lower end of the market is genuinely adequate, because the job is explaining ideas clearly rather than marking to criteria. Families buying here should be paying nearer the bottom of the published bands, not the top.

The tutor teaches the criteria, questions whether the research question can actually be answered with the evidence available, and flags where analysis has become description. No text is supplied.

sections.heading: What the cheapest Business tutor in Dubai actually delivers
paragraphs: The published floor of the Dubai market is around AED 33 to 65 an hour, from Tutopiya and EdFlik. Families often dismiss it on principle, which is a mistake, and families often buy it for the wrong job, which is a more expensive mistake. At that rate the tutor is normally a graduate or senior student who knows the material and has not marked it. What that buys is explanation: a clear account of why contribution per unit matters, worked slowly, with the student asking questions.

For a DP1 student three weeks behind on finance and accounts, that is the correct purchase. The gap is informational, the fix is exposition, and paying AED 270 an hour for exposition is paying a specialist to do a non-specialist job. A family that buys cheaply and well in DP1 has money left for the term that actually needs it.

The band stops working at the point where marking begins. A tutor who has not read against the published criteria cannot tell a student that their research project has described a marketing strategy where the criterion wanted it evaluated, and cannot tell them that a Paper 2 answer lost four method marks by not showing working. Those judgements are what the AED 150 to 300 band is for, and the AED 200 to 450 and above band in the exam year.

So the honest spending shape for Business Management in Dubai is not a flat rate across two years. It is low in DP1, concentrated and higher around the research project, and higher again for a short block of Paper 2 technique before the mock window and the May session. Pages that quote one number for the whole course are not describing how the subject is actually used.

sections.heading: The Business Management assessment structure and its weightings
paragraphs: Business Management is assessed through two examination papers and one internally assessed research project, and the balance between them differs by level in a way that changes revision priorities. Families should confirm the exact current weightings against the subject guide with their school's Diploma Programme coordinator, because the course was revised recently and older pages in this market still quote the previous structure.

On the current structure, Standard Level candidates sit Paper 1 and Paper 2 and submit the research project, with the project carrying the larger internal share. Higher Level candidates sit longer versions of both papers, cover extension content in each unit, and submit the same research project with a smaller share of the total grade. The headline consequence is that an HL candidate's examination technique carries more weight than an SL candidate's, while an SL candidate's project carries more.

Paper 1 is based on a pre-released case study, which is unusual and widely under-exploited. Students are given the case ahead of the examination and many of them read it rather than work it: they know the organisation's story and have not mapped it against the tools they will be asked to apply. Working the pre-released case properly, tool by tool, is one of the highest-return activities available in this subject and it can be done months in advance.

Paper 2 is unseen data response with quantitative content and extended response questions. This is where method marks live, and where they are abandoned. A student who shows no working on a break-even calculation and arrives at the wrong number scores nothing, where the same student showing working would have collected most of the marks available.

sections.heading: The business research project: 1,800 words and a real organisation
paragraphs: The internally assessed project asks the student to investigate a real organisation against a research question of their own, using primary and secondary research, in no more than 1,800 words. Every part of that sentence causes trouble. The organisation has to be real and reachable. The question has to be answerable with evidence the student can actually get. And 1,800 words is far less room than students assume.

The failure that costs most is choosing a question the evidence cannot answer. A student picks a large multinational because there is plenty written about it, then discovers that nothing published addresses their specific question and no one will answer an email. A smaller Dubai organisation that will give twenty minutes to a student is worth more than a famous name that will not, and this is one place where living in a commercial city is a genuine advantage.

The second failure is length. Students write 2,600 words and then delete adjectives, which removes their analysis rather than their padding. The fix is structural and happens before drafting: allocate the 1,800 words across sections against the criteria, and write to the allocation. A tutor can do that allocation with a student in one session, which prevents a fortnight of painful cutting in December.

The boundary on this component is the one that matters most in this market. A tutor may teach the criteria by name with their mark allocations, interrogate the research question, discuss whether the chosen research methods will produce usable evidence, read the student's own draft and respond with questions and criteria references, and point to a paragraph that has described rather than analysed. A tutor may not write any part of the project, rewrite sentences, or supply text. Producing assessed work is malpractice under IB rules and the consequence falls on the student.

sections.heading: Tools students name and never apply
paragraphs: Business Management supplies a toolkit and marks its application, not its recall. The commonest capped answer in this subject lists a tool, defines it accurately, and never uses it on the organisation in the question. An examiner cannot award application marks for a correct definition, however neatly set out.

The pattern repeats across the toolkit. A student writes out the four quadrants of a product portfolio matrix and does not place the case organisation's products in them. They explain what a stakeholder map shows and do not identify which of this organisation's stakeholders conflict. They define market segmentation and never say which segment the case company is actually serving. Each of those is a two-sentence fix once it has been pointed out on the student's own script.

The deeper habit behind it is a reading problem. Students approach a case by extracting facts and then selecting tools; stronger candidates read the case asking what decision the organisation faces, which selects the tool automatically. That reframing takes one session with a pre-released case and changes Paper 1 performance for the rest of the year.

The reverse error exists too, and is more common among confident students in a commercial city. They write knowledgeably about business from general experience, quoting what their family's company does, and apply no framework at all. The mark scheme has nowhere to put that, and the answer reads as opinion. Both errors come from the same misunderstanding of what the subject rewards.

sections.heading: Business Management, Economics and IGCSE Business compared
paragraphs: Dubai families choosing between these three, or moving between them, usually do so on an assumption that turns out to be wrong: that they are the same subject at different difficulties. They reward different behaviour, and a student who transfers habits from one to another loses marks for reasons nobody explains.

IGCSE Business rewards accurate recall and straightforward application, with short structured questions and a predictable command vocabulary. Diploma Programme Business Management rewards sustained application to a specific organisation and a justified recommendation at the end. A student arriving in DP1 with a strong IGCSE Business grade often writes DP answers that are correct, complete and capped, because nothing in them weighs an option against an alternative.

Economics is the other direction of confusion. It rewards theoretical modelling, diagram work and evaluation of policy, using real examples as illustration. Business rewards the opposite emphasis: the organisation is the subject and theory is the instrument. Students taking both, which many Dubai DP students do, need the distinction made explicit early, because the two registers sound similar and score very differently.

The practical consequence for route choice in Year 11 is to look at what a student enjoys doing rather than what they know. A student who likes building and critiquing a model usually prefers Economics. A student who likes working out what a particular company should do next usually prefers Business Management. Both are respectable routes to a commerce degree, and neither is the softer option.

sections.heading: The quantitative half of Business, and the method marks nobody claims
paragraphs: Business Management carries more arithmetic than its reputation suggests, and the marks attached to it are among the most reliably winnable in the subject. Ratio analysis, break-even and contribution, cash flow forecasting and simple investment appraisal all appear in Paper 2 and all follow fixed procedures. Unlike an extended response, there is no judgement involved: the method is either applied or it is not.

Students lose these marks in two ways, both mechanical. The first is not showing working. Method marks exist precisely so that a candidate who sets out the calculation correctly and then mis-divides still collects most of the credit, and a student who writes only a final figure throws that protection away. The second is calculating and stopping. A liquidity ratio that is computed and never interpreted answers half the question, and the interpretation half usually carries the discretionary marks.

There is a third, subtler loss around units and periods. Cash flow questions mix months and quarters; ratio questions mix figures from a balance sheet and an income statement covering different periods. Students who do not label what they are working with produce internally inconsistent answers that look careless to an examiner even when the understanding is sound.

All of this is fixable by drilling, which is why it is the best value in the subject. A block of four or five sessions on Paper 2 quantitative items, worked under time with working shown and interpretation written each time, reliably moves marks. It is also a component where the student can self-check afterwards, which makes the tutoring hours go further than they do on essay technique.

sections.heading: Dubai as a source of real organisations for the research project
paragraphs: One advantage of studying Business Management in Dubai is rarely used: the city is full of organisations at a scale a student can actually research. The emirate's private education sector alone ran 227 schools serving 387,441 students across 17 curricula in 2024-25, and the commercial environment around it, from logistics to retail to food service, includes thousands of firms small enough to answer a student's questions and large enough to have decisions worth analysing.

That matters because the research project lives or dies on evidence access. A student who selects a global technology company will find plenty of secondary material and no primary research, and the criteria reward both. A student who selects a single-branch business in their own community, with an owner willing to spend twenty minutes answering questions about a specific decision, has primary data nobody else has and a question with a real answer.

There are honest constraints to respect. A student conducting primary research should be transparent about who they are and what the work is for, should not promise the organisation anything, and should handle any commercial information carefully. Where a family member's business is used, the analysis has to stay analytical, which is harder than it sounds and is the commonest reason these projects read as promotional.

The tutoring role here is scoping, not sourcing. A tutor can ask whether the chosen organisation will realistically respond, whether the research question can be answered with the evidence available, and whether the chosen methods will generate usable data. Selecting the organisation and conducting the research is the student's own work, and should stay that way.

sections.heading: Online Business tuition against the in-home market in Dubai
paragraphs: Families comparing an online platform with a visiting tutor are making a real decision, and the published numbers make it concrete rather than rhetorical. IB Gram does not sell home visits in the UAE at all, so this table reports the market and then states what we do.

Travel is the term that is never itemised. A tutor driving from Jumeirah to Mirdif on a weekday evening gives up an hour each way for a one-hour session, and somebody pays for those two hours. It also narrows the pool to specialists prepared to make that journey at that time, which in the exam term is a short list. The advertised package comparison, AED 799 a month for eight online sessions against AED 1,599 to 1,799 for four two-hour visits, is the clearest available measure of the difference.

The case for in-home work deserves stating fairly. Younger students concentrate better with an adult in the room. Equipment problems do not arise. For a student who needs supervision as much as teaching, physical presence does something video does not. For a DP Business candidate working on research project criteria or Paper 2 method, the decisive question is whether the tutor marks that component, and the wider pool answers it better.

The test for any provider, ours included, is specific: ask which Business Management component the tutor worked on most recently, at which level, and how they would respond to a research project draft of 2,400 words. A precise answer tells you more than an address does.

sections.heading: What UAE universities and MoE equivalency need from a Business student
paragraphs: Business Management students in Dubai frequently plan to study in the UAE, which brings the Ministry of Education equivalency process into view. It is worth describing accurately, because one ranking competitor in this market publishes the wrong subject count and families act on it.

For the British track, the Ministry requires proof of one accredited subject at Advanced Level with a grade of no less than E, or two accredited subjects at Advanced Subsidiary Level at the same grade, together with passes in five accredited subjects in GCSE or IGCSE certificates at a grade no lower than E or grade 3. Arabic and Islamic education are not included among those five required subjects. For the American track, English proficiency is evidenced by IELTS academic 5, TOEFL iBT 61 or 450 in the SAT reading and writing section, and mathematics by at least 450 in the SAT Math test.

For the International Baccalaureate route there is a point of honesty that most pages skip: we are not publishing an IB points threshold for equivalency, because no such figure has been read on the Ministry's own pages during this research. A number that matters this much should come from moe.gov.ae or the emirate's attestation authority, not from an aggregator. Families should check directly and ask their school's university counsellor.

Two things follow. Equivalency and attestation are processes families complete with the authorities, not services a tutoring platform performs or guarantees, and nobody should imply otherwise. And tutoring is not a requirement for equivalency, admission or progression; suggesting it is would be a false urgency claim about a regulatory process.

process.title: Send a marked Business script or a project draft
process.description: A returned Paper 2 attempt or a research project draft with the teacher's comments shows where marks are being lost in a way no questionnaire does. Method marks missing from a calculation and description in place of analysis are both visible in minutes.

process.title: Say which band the job needs
process.description: Content catch-up in DP1 belongs near the bottom of the published market. Research project criteria work and Paper 2 technique do not. Being explicit about which job this is stops a family paying specialist rates for exposition.

process.title: Meet the matched tutor at no charge
process.description: The trial is a working session on the student's own material. The tutor names the pattern, says what the first sessions would address and how many are realistic, and the family decides afterwards. No obligation either way.

process.title: Fix the slot in Gulf Standard Time
process.description: Sessions sit around the Dubai school day, mandatory subject lessons, sport and prayer times, and shift for Ramadan or exam weeks with no journey to rearrange. Weekly, fortnightly or a bounded block, depending on the component.

process.title: Review against components, then stop
process.description: Progress is checked against measurable things: method marks claimed, recommendations justified, project words allocated against criteria. When the component is done, the block ends. Rolling support with nothing due is the pattern we would rather you did not buy.

whyPoints.title: Cheapest band explained honestly
whyPoints.description: Most pages in this market hide the bottom of the market or imply it is worthless. For DP1 content gaps it is often the right purchase, and saying so costs us the easy sale and gives a Dubai family a usable plan for two years.

whyPoints.title: The 1,800-word limit treated as a structure
whyPoints.description: The research project is planned as a word allocation against criteria before drafting, rather than cut back from 2,600 words in December. Deleting adjectives removes analysis, which is why over-length drafts lose marks twice.

whyPoints.title: Quantitative method drilled, not discussed
whyPoints.description: Ratios, break-even, cash flow and investment appraisal follow fixed procedures and carry method marks. Working shown and interpretation written each time is the cheapest reliable mark gain available in this subject.

whyPoints.title: A clean line on assessed work
whyPoints.description: A tutor teaches criteria, interrogates a research question and reads the student's own draft. Nobody supplies text or rewrites a paragraph. Producing coursework is malpractice under IB rules and the consequence falls on the candidate.

whyPoints.title: Equivalency described, never claimed
whyPoints.description: The British-track requirements are quoted from a sourced report; the IB points figure is deliberately absent because it has not been read on the Ministry's own pages. No provider should perform, guarantee or imply control over equivalency.

whyPoints.title: Delivery stated without hedging
whyPoints.description: One-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time. IB Gram runs no home visits in the UAE; that service exists only in India, so no family should finish this page expecting a tutor at a Dubai address.

faqs.question: What is the cheapest way to get IB Business help in Dubai?
faqs.answer: The published floor of the market is roughly AED 33 to 65 an hour, with Tutopiya advertising from AED 33 to 52 and EdFlik from AED 45 to 65. At that rate the tutor usually explains rather than marks, which is the right purchase for a DP1 student with a content gap and the wrong one for research project criteria work. Small-group sessions and fortnightly rather than weekly slots also reduce monthly spend. Those are the providers' own published figures, read in October 2026, and not an IB Gram price list.

faqs.question: How long is the IB Business research project and what does it need?
faqs.answer: A maximum of 1,800 words on a real organisation, built around a research question of the student's own and supported by primary and secondary research. The practical constraints are access and length. A question nobody can answer with available evidence will not work regardless of how interesting it is, and 1,800 words is far less room than students assume. Allocating the words across sections against the criteria before drafting prevents the painful December exercise of cutting 800 words out of a finished piece.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with the Business research project without crossing a line?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the line is clear. A tutor can teach the assessment criteria with their mark allocations, interrogate the research question, discuss whether chosen methods will produce usable evidence, read a draft the student wrote and respond with questions and criteria references, and point at a paragraph that describes where it should analyse. A tutor cannot write any part of the project, rewrite sentences or supply text. Producing assessed work is malpractice under IB rules and the penalty falls on the candidate, not the provider.

faqs.question: Why does my child's Business answer get full marks for knowledge and nothing for application?
faqs.answer: Because the tool was named and never used. Business Management marks application to the organisation in the question, not recall of the framework. A student who sets out the four quadrants of a product portfolio matrix accurately and never places the case company's products inside them has written a correct definition, and an examiner has nowhere to award application credit. The fix is usually two sentences per tool, pointed out on the student's own script, and it is one of the fastest mark gains in the subject.

faqs.question: Does anyone come to our address in Dubai for Business lessons?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram provides no home visits anywhere in the UAE; in-home tutoring is a service we offer only in India. Business support for Dubai families is delivered one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time, scheduled around the school day. The in-home market here is real and quoted at AED 180 to 500 an hour with travel inside that rate, and advertised in-home packages run AED 1,599 to 1,799 a month against AED 799 for eight online sessions. We would rather you had the right specialist than a short drive.

faqs.question: Should my child take Business Management at HL or SL in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Higher Level adds extension content in each content area and longer examination papers, with the research project carrying a smaller share of the total grade. Standard Level has less content and the project counts for more. In practice, a student who writes well under time pressure and wants a commerce degree benefits from HL; a student whose strength is sustained research rather than timed extended responses often does better with the SL balance. Confirm what the school's option blocks actually permit before planning, because that often decides it.

faqs.question: Is Business Management easier than Economics in the IB?
faqs.answer: Neither is easier; they reward different behaviour. Economics marks theoretical modelling, diagram work and evaluation of policy, with real examples as illustration. Business Management marks sustained application to a named organisation ending in a justified recommendation. Students who write one in the register of the other lose marks in both, which is the commonest problem for Dubai students taking both courses. A student who enjoys working out what a specific company should do next usually prefers Business; one who enjoys building and critiquing models usually prefers Economics.

faqs.question: How should my child use the pre-released Business case study?
faqs.answer: By working it, not reading it. Paper 1 is set on a case released in advance, and most students read the organisation's story repeatedly without mapping it against the tools they will be asked to apply. The productive approach is to take each major tool in the course and ask what it says about this organisation, writing the answer out. That can be done months ahead, which makes it one of the few genuinely front-loadable parts of the Diploma Programme and a good use of cheaper tutoring hours.

faqs.question: Which Business calculations appear most often in Paper 2?
faqs.answer: Ratio analysis, break-even and contribution, cash flow forecasting and simple investment appraisal are the recurring families of quantitative question. All follow fixed procedures, which makes them reliably winnable, and all carry method marks that are forfeited when working is not shown. The second recurring loss is calculating and stopping: a liquidity ratio computed and never interpreted answers half the question, and the interpretation usually carries the discretionary marks. A short block of timed practice with working written out moves these marks dependably.

faqs.question: Can my child research a family business in Dubai for the project?
faqs.answer: Yes, and access to a cooperative organisation is a real advantage, but the analysis has to stay analytical. Projects built on a family firm frequently read as promotional, which the criteria do not reward, and the student has to be willing to identify weaknesses in a business their parents run. Be transparent with the organisation about what the work is for, promise nothing, and handle commercial information carefully. A smaller business that answers questions properly is usually worth more than a famous name that answers none.

faqs.question: What does the UAE Ministry of Education require for British curriculum equivalency?
faqs.answer: Reported requirements are passes in five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at a grade no lower than E or grade 3, with Arabic and Islamic education not counted among those five, plus either one accredited Advanced Level subject at no less than E or two Advanced Subsidiary Level subjects at the same grade. For the American track, English proficiency is evidenced by IELTS academic 5, TOEFL iBT 61 or 450 in SAT reading and writing, and mathematics by at least 450 in SAT Math. Verify the current rules on moe.gov.ae before acting.

faqs.question: Will my child's Diploma need a specific points total for a UAE university?
faqs.answer: Not one we are willing to print. No Diploma Programme points threshold for Ministry of Education equivalency has been read on the Ministry's own pages during this research, and a figure this consequential should come from moe.gov.ae or the emirate's attestation authority rather than from an aggregator or a tutoring company. One ranking page in this market already publishes an incorrect subject count for the British track, which shows how these errors propagate. Ask your school's university counsellor and check the official channel directly.

faqs.question: Do Business tutors working privately in Dubai need a permit?
faqs.answer: Yes. The MoHRE private tuition work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, applies to any individual providing private tuition in the UAE. It is granted free of charge for two years, and eligible applicants include registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed individuals, school students aged 15 to 18 and university students. MoHRE's own service page lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time through its smart app, website and e-services system, and warns that tutoring without a permit attracts fines and penalties under the applicable laws.

faqs.question: How many sessions does a Business research project block usually run to?
faqs.answer: Commonly five or six, spread across the life of the project rather than bunched. One at the start to test whether the research question can be answered with evidence the student can reach, one on method and word allocation before drafting, two on drafts with criteria feedback, and one near submission on whether analysis has arrived where description was. Buying continuous weekly support across the whole project period usually costs more and adds little, because the student needs time between sessions to do the research.

faqs.question: What if no Business Management specialist is free in the week we want?
faqs.answer: We say so instead of substituting quietly. Demand for exam-term Business support concentrates sharply around mocks and the May session, and the pool for a specific component in a specific fortnight is narrower than families expect. The options are a start date in the future, a tutor who covers the level but not that exact component for interim work, or a recommendation to wait until demand eases. Families are entitled to know which of those they are being offered, and concealed substitution is the failure mode worth watching for here.

dubai/ib-business-tutor.closingHeading: Buy the band the job needs
dubai/ib-business-tutor.closingBody: Send a marked Business script or a project draft, say which component is at risk, and take a free trial session. The tutor will say honestly whether this is a job for the cheaper end of the Dubai market or for criteria-level marking, and how many sessions it realistically takes. A family that buys cheaply and well in DP1 has money left for the term that needs it. Sessions run one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time; home visits are not part of our UAE service. Every AED figure on this page is published by the provider named and was read in October 2026.

dubai/ib-cas-guidance.tutorsIntro: The tutors here help a student plan and evidence CAS rather than teach a subject. The work is mapping existing activities to outcomes, finding the gaps, understanding what the CAS project requires, and turning what a student already does into reflections that satisfy a coordinator.

intro.heading: No marks, no grade, and still a failing condition
paragraphs: CAS is one of the three core elements of the Diploma, alongside Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay. It stands for Creativity, Activity and Service, it runs across the whole Diploma, and it is the only part of the programme that produces no mark, no grade and no points. That fact leads a great many students to treat it as optional, which is a serious mistake: completion of CAS to the school's satisfaction is a requirement for the award of the Diploma. A candidate with forty points and incomplete CAS does not receive the Diploma.

The requirement is not about hours. The old guidance that attached an hour count to CAS no longer governs, and what replaced it is harder to fake: the student must demonstrate all seven learning outcomes through evidence in a portfolio, complete at least one CAS project of at least a month involving collaboration, and sustain engagement across roughly eighteen months. Hours can be accumulated in a fortnight. Evidence of all seven outcomes cannot.

That changes what help is useful. Nobody can do CAS for a student, and nobody should try. What goes wrong is almost always organisational: a student has in fact done plenty, has evidenced four outcomes well, has never knowingly addressed the other three, has no CAS project, and discovers this at an interview with eight weeks of the Diploma left. At that point the problem is real and the solutions are poor.

The useful intervention is early mapping. A student who sits down in the first term of the Diploma, lists everything they already do, maps it against the seven outcomes and sees which two or three are unevidenced can usually cover the gaps by adjusting activities they were doing anyway. The same exercise in the final term means inventing commitments, which is both stressful and visible to a coordinator who has read hundreds of portfolios.

Dubai adds its own planning constraints, and they are predictable enough to work around. Outdoor activity is impractical for several months of the year. The long summer break removes most students from the city entirely. Service opportunities generally run through registered organisations and school-approved partners rather than through informal arrangements. Ramadan creates genuine service opportunities and also changes the rhythm of the school day. A CAS plan that ignores all of this tends to collapse in the second year.

Our help is planning and reflection coaching, delivered online one-to-one. We map outcomes, identify gaps, explain what a CAS project needs, and teach a student what a reflection must contain to serve as evidence. The student chooses their activities, carries them out and writes their own portfolio, and their CAS coordinator remains the only person who can determine whether CAS is complete.
bullets: No marks, no grade, and incomplete CAS means no Diploma
Seven learning outcomes, all of which need evidence
At least one CAS project of a month or more, with collaboration
Roughly eighteen months of sustained engagement
Hours are not the requirement; evidenced outcomes are
